title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 27 March 2026. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Galle, Matara, Kalutara and Nuwara-Eliya districts during the evening or night. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, North-central and Uva provinces and in Kurunegala, Vavuniya, Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
